text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it introduced coverage of Whittman-Hart Inc with a market performer rating for the intermediate term and outperform for the long term.
-- EVEREN noted the information technology strategic planning market is large and rapidly growing and Whittman-Hart has increased its revenues by 37 percent annually over the last five years.
-- Based on its earnings estimates of $0.43 per share for 1997 and $0.63 for 1998, EVEREN said it set price targets for Whittman-Hart of $17 for six months and $24 for 18 months.
-- Whittman-Hart provides information technology consulting services.
-- Its shares were unchanged Wednesday at 15-3/4.
